description: Market cap, P/E, P/B, P/S, EV/EBITDA, EV/revenue and dividend yield on a share price you pass (1 to 25 per call), joined to point-in-time SEC EDGAR filings. Pass a price only from `get_price_history` (a graded daily close; put its `close_source` and grade in `source_label`), or one the user gave you or a tool the user connected returned in this conversation; never from memory. Each row needs the price date, the close, its currency and (for the record) where it came from in `source_label`, e.g. the `get_price_history` source, your market-data provider, broker export or internal price database. RULES: a price joins only filings accepted BEFORE it was observed (default 16:00 New York on `price_date`); a ticker means the company that held it ON `price_date`; splits effective after the filing and on or before the price date are applied to the filed share count and per-share figures, and a split between period end and filing is not (the filing already holds it); a company with more than one listed share class gets no multiple at all (`multi_class_price_needed`); a price in another currency needs `fx_rate`; a `total_return` close is refused; a `split_adjusted` close needs `adjusted_through`. OUTPUT per price: `metrics`, `metrics_display` (QUOTE VERBATIM), `metrics_provenance` (each figure's `derived_id`, the filed `fact_id`s behind it and `rests_on: ["user_supplied_price"]`), `metrics_unavailable` (why a figure is null), `warnings`, and `price_inputs_echo` (the price exactly as you sent it, `basis: "user_supplied"`). When you write a figure that rests on a price, state the price, its date and its source beside the figure (a user's price is called user-supplied; a `get_price_history` close is cited with its grade and IEX or SEC attribution); cite the `derived_id` so `verify_facts` can re-run it. The price is never called current. Check that your price and the filing use the same share basis; a split missing from the corporate-action table is not detected. Nothing is stored. Use `as_of_date` to cap the filings used. Plan: every plan, including no sign-in.

as_of_date.description: Optional cap, YYYY-MM-DD: only filings accepted before the end of this day are used, even when a price is later.

prices.description: 1 to 25 prices, one per company and date.

adjusted_through.description: For split_adjusted: the date the adjustment runs to (YYYY-MM-DD).

adjustment.description: How the close was adjusted; default raw. split_adjusted needs adjusted_through. total_return is refused for multiples.

as_of.description: When the price was observed, ISO 8601 with offset. Default: 16:00 America/New_York on price_date.

cik.description: SEC Central Index Key of the company. Preferred over a ticker.

close.description: Closing price per share, in `currency`: above 0, at most 10,000,000, at most 8 decimal places.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency of the close, e.g. USD.

fx_rate.description: Units of the company's reporting currency per 1 unit of `currency`; needed when the currencies differ. Also yours.

price_date.description: Date the close belongs to, YYYY-MM-DD. Required: a price without a date is refused.

source_label.description: Your own note on where the price came from, at most 64 characters. Shown as yours.

ticker.description: Ticker, resolved to the company that held it ON price_date (recycled tickers map by date).
